00_OpenMail.fused.title: OpenMail
00_OpenMail.fused.description: A local-first multi-account Gmail client: thread list, reading pane, compose, labels and full Gmail search, with fused.ai catch-up briefings, thread summaries and an approval-gated triage board.

01_OpenBot.fused.title: OpenBot
01_OpenBot.fused.description: Autonomous browsing bots on your own machine: each gets a headless Chrome, a chat thread for tasks, scheduled routines and reusable skills. Runs as a resident worker.

02_DoodleShooter.fused.title: Doodle District
02_DoodleShooter.fused.description: A first-person survival shooter drawn in ballpoint on notebook paper. Grapple, slice bullets back, lob grenades. Everything is procedural three.js, no Python.

03_OpenRelax.fused.title: Open Relax
03_OpenRelax.fused.description: A break-time companion: mix generated ambient sounds, follow guided breathing, and track daily minutes with a goal ring, heatmap and badges. Reminders ring as macOS notifications.

04_ClaudeUsage.fused.title: Claude Usage
04_ClaudeUsage.fused.description: A dashboard of your Claude Code token usage and limits across accounts, read from the local Claude Code state with fused.runPython.

05_OpenWhisper.fused.title: OpenWhisper
05_OpenWhisper.fused.description: Local, offline speech-to-text for macOS. Press the mic, talk, and Whisper types the transcript into whatever app has focus. Audio never leaves the machine.

06_OpenColor.fused.title: OpenColor
06_OpenColor.fused.description: A color palette explorer: pick a base color and build complementary, triadic, analogous or monochrome harmonies with WCAG contrast checks and CSS export.

07_OpenDesign.fused.title: OpenDesign
07_OpenDesign.fused.description: Turn an app idea into a near-final UI mock plus a build brief for an AI coding agent, rendered with fused.ai.image or a remote endpoint.

08_OpenSVG.fused.title: OpenSVG
08_OpenSVG.fused.description: Trace raster images into SVG. Drop a PNG or JPG, tune colour count, simplification and curve smoothing, and export. A numpy and Pillow tracer via fused.runPython.

09_OpenCPU.fused.title: OpenCPU
09_OpenCPU.fused.description: Find and kill running processes on macOS and Linux, modelled on Raycast's Kill Process: filter live, kill one or a whole tree, killall, or restart.

10_OpenScreen.fused.title: OpenScreen
10_OpenScreen.fused.description: A screen recorder: record your screen from the page, keep the recordings in a searchable library with metadata, and export clips.

11_ShatteredGlass.fused.title: Shattered Glass
11_ShatteredGlass.fused.description: An interactive broken-mirror effect: an image fractures into Voronoi shards that act as tilted mirrors and shift with parallax. Drop your own picture or use the camera.

12_Focusly.fused.title: Focusly
12_Focusly.fused.description: A single-page focus timer. Name the task, start a session, and log finished and abandoned sessions with a daily summary. No server or Python.

13_FusedWeb.fused.title: Fused Web
13_FusedWeb.fused.description: Build HTTP APIs as Fused UDFs from plain-language prompts. Each project is a canvas pushed with the fused CLI and served through its share token.

14_Transcripto.fused.title: Transcripto
14_Transcripto.fused.description: Turn YouTube videos and local recordings into searchable transcripts, with one-click summaries via fused.ai.text and export to text or SRT.
